description: Write a pandas ETL script for health_portal that prepares a research extract with k-anonymity (k = 3) over the quasi-identifiers age and zip code. The script should: (1) generalize age into 10-year bands ('30-39', ...; 90 and above become '90+'), (2) generalize zip_code to its first 3 characters (zip3), (3) count records per (age_band, zip3) group, (4) suppress groups smaller than k by replacing both age_band and zip3 with '*', (5) drop direct identifiers (patient_id, name), (6) report the number of suppressed records and verify that no remaining generalized group is smaller than k.
edge_cases: Band boundaries: 39 falls in '30-39' and 40 in '40-49'; pd.cut with the default right-closed bins puts 40 into the 30-40 band
zip_code must be handled as a string: '02134' read as an integer yields zip3 '213' instead of '021'
pt4 shares zip3 941 with the first three records but is alone in its (age_band, zip3) group and must be suppressed
In the sample the suppressed group itself has only 2 records, below k; the script must flag this residual risk in its report rather than claim compliance
patient_id and name must not appear in the output
common_failure_modes: FM3: Group sizes counted on one quasi-identifier at a time instead of on their combination
FM7: No post-check that every released group has at least k records
FM5: Numeric zip codes lose leading zeros before truncation
